verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's MCP docs list a Create-Dashboard tool that builds a dashboard from reports and text cards, which shows dashboards composed of reports exist. Marketing copy describes a dashboard "you and your team can keep working from" and "one interactive view" for team alignment. That covers composing reports into a team-facing dashboard, but the evidence is thin on saving insights and on how sharing works. Missing for 10: first-party dashboard docs for the UI workflow, documentation of saving Insights reports to dashboards, sharing and permission controls for teammates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
